omitted.reason: Cross-scenario workflow contract. Its consumer is a workflow builder or the control plane, not this scenario's CLI: browsing and merging peer catalogs is fleet-level surface (docs/concepts/COMPOSITION.md, 'Search and manage operations'). Read it with curl against the Connect procedure.
Server-streaming progress RPC. Exposed via the hand-appended `jobs watch` command (register.go) because cli-manifest/v1 bindings model unary connect-rpc calls only.

Host-aware candidate menu for the in-product model picker (a UI affordance). The same facts are available on the CLI in composable pieces: `models list --operation <op>` (catalog), `models select <op>` (the chosen model + gpu_viable), and `backends doctor` (host-tool readiness).
Hardware snapshot for the model-catalog UI's host-aware fit chips (a UI affordance). The CLI already exposes host hardware via the root `vrooli host inventory --json`.
